["The held evidence indicates the order was not operative on 2026-10-14, so no YES claim is submitted. Section 5 (the Committee is continued until September 30, 2005) ended by its own terms on 2005-09-30 (the U.S. Code note to 42 U.S.C. 15001 records that EO 13309 section 5 extended the term to that date and later orders extended it further). Sections 1 to 4 renamed the committee and amended EO 12994; EO 13446 section 5 (2007-09-28) then amended EO 12994 as amended to read as follows, restating the whole text of EO 12994 with the new name and members, and the held U.S. Code note prints the committee's text as that restatement. Whether the 2007 restatement ended EO 13309's amendments (the owner strike-and-insert ruling treats restatement of a section as continuing the clause, but here the whole parent text was replaced) and whether EO 12994 itself was continued through 2026-10-14 depend on later continuation orders (EO 13385, 13511 and later orders listed in the Code note) that are not in the packet's citable evidence; only ACTOR_TEXT:EO:13446 is. Needed: the continuation orders through 2026-10-14 and a ruling on a whole-text restatement. Formal status: no revocation found."]
